description: This file defines a React component for a CSV upload page in a Next.js application, handling file selection, CSV parsing, and UI rendering including preview and instructions. It includes interactions with authentication context and routing.

methods.name: UploadInner
methods.description: Main React component handling CSV upload, preview, and navigation logic.

methods.name: UploadPage
methods.description: Wrapper component providing authentication context to UploadInner.

methods.name: handleFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a CSV file, updating state with parsed data or error.
